plotSections.title: Ord severs the tentacle on Gerk
bullets: Ord's Holy Weapon (concentration) strikes as a blinding radiant arc, mostly radiant with very little slashing, and severs the tentacle grasping Gerk.
The cut end flails; the rest collapses like stagnant water and splashes into a puddle of semi-tacky, gooey black liquid, thicker than water and closer to frog spawn than tar.

plotSections.title: The tentacles still coming through
bullets: More tentacles remain. The DM first says seven more, then confirms two are coming through the opening: one had struck Sylan and one had struck Gerk.

Ord moves to the tentacle on Sylan, spends inspiration, hits, and burns a 4th-level smite. The blow takes off most of that tentacle, but it stays intact and the strike is less bright than the first. Across the turn he deals over a hundred damage, with his bonus action already used.

plotSections.title: The tentacles strike Ord
bullets: A tentacle tries to grapple Ord. His Athletics ties the contest and the tie goes to him, so it wraps him and then falls away without holding.
A second tentacle hits him twice for 19 and 12 bludgeoning.

plotSections.title: Sylan cuts the wounded tentacle
bullets: Sylan uses Sentinel when Ord is hit and crits the tentacle Ord had wounded with his +1 greatsword, for 29 damage including radiant. The blade cleaves it further, but tendrils still hold it together.

On his turn the tentacles are only flailing, none currently grappling. He stays on that same tentacle. Flanking is impossible: it is a tentacle coming out of a door, not a creature that can be flanked. He hits; the damage count is still underway when the chunk ends (sword damage plus 3 radiant).

chronologicalEvents: Ord's Holy Weapon severs the tentacle grasping Gerk; the stump flails and the rest splashes down as black, frog-spawn-like goo.
Two tentacles are still coming through the opening after one each had struck Sylan and Gerk.
Ord attacks the tentacle on Sylan with inspiration and a 4th-level smite, dealing about 45 damage and over a hundred for the turn. Most of the tentacle is severed, but it remains intact.
That tentacle fails a contested grapple on Ord, then the other hits him for 19 and 12 bludgeoning.
Sylan's Sentinel reaction crits the wounded tentacle for 29 damage with his +1 greatsword; tendrils still hold it.
Sylan continues on that tentacle. The DM rules he cannot flank a tentacle emerging from a door. His hit lands as the chunk cuts off.

Ord.existing: Dragonborn paladin and Gatekeeper of Feldspar.
notes: Holy Weapon is up and concentrating; the strike reads as a radiant, lightsaber-like arc with little actual slashing.

Severed the tentacle that was grasping Gerk, then spent inspiration and a 4th-level smite on the tentacle attacking Sylan. That second blow was dimmer and left the tentacle intact after removing most of it. He dealt over a hundred damage and had already used his bonus action.
Won a contested Athletics grapple on a tie, so a tentacle could not hold him, then took 19 and 12 bludgeoning from the follow-up hits.
Uses Sentinel: when an ally is hit, he can strike as a reaction. He did so when Ord was hit, critting the tentacle Ord had wounded.
Fights with a +1 greatsword that also deals radiant damage. The reaction dealt 29 total, including radiant from a d8, and still left tendrils holding the tentacle.
On his turn he kept attacking that flailing tentacle and was told he cannot flank it because it comes out of a door.

Gerk.existing: Half-orc barbarian, Doorman, and Child of the Tree.
notes: A tentacle was grasping him until Ord severed it. Another of the tentacles coming through the opening had also struck him.
Tentacles reach through a hole or door and grasp or lash. One was holding Gerk; two more were coming through after having struck Sylan and Gerk.
When severed, the end flails and the rest falls like stagnant water, leaving a puddle of semi-tacky black goo with the consistency of frog spawn, not quite tar.
They attempt grapples and deal bludgeoning. The one Ord and Sylan focused stayed intact on remaining tendrils after both a heavy smite and a crit.
They cannot be flanked; they are appendages coming out of a door.

newTerms.name: Black goo tentacles
notes: Unnamed tentacles emerging from a hole or door. Severed flesh collapses into semi-tacky black liquid like frog spawn. They grapple and deal bludgeoning, and cannot be flanked.
